# commander_new_address (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a **New (NSF) Address** record by **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an NSF Address record by title or UID.
data "commander_new_address" "example" {
  location = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_TITLE_OR_UID_"
}

output "address_id" {
  value = data.commander_new_address.example.id
}

output "address_title" {
  value = data.commander_new_address.example.title
}

output "address_notes" {
  value = data.commander_new_address.example.notes
}

output "address_folder_location" {
  value = data.commander_new_address.example.folder_location
}

output "address_details" {
  value = data.commander_new_address.example.address
}

output "address_custom" {
  value = data.commander_new_address.example.custom
}

output "address_share" {
  value = data.commander_new_address.example.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Address record **title** or **UID** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `address` (Attributes) Physical address (`address` field). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address))
- `custom` (Attributes List) Custom fields stored in the record's `custom` array. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.
- `notes` (String) Note of the record.
- `share` (Map of String) Mapping of share permissions for this folder or record. For folders, keys can identify either users (**UID** or **email**) or teams (**UID** or **name**). For records, keys can identify users only (**UID** or **email**). Values specify the permission level: `viewer`, `share-manager`, `content-manager`, `content-share-manager`, or `full-manager`. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries.
- `title` (String) Record title.

<a id="nestedatt--address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `address`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `state` (String) State or province.
- `street1` (String) Street line 1.
- `street2` (String) Street line 2.
- `zip` (String) Postal code.


<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value should be treated as **sensitive**.
- `type` (String) Keeper field **type** (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field **value** (JSON-encoded for complex types).
